values.meaning: Total number of cannonball waves fired
values.quote: calling down 12 waves of cannonballs in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds

values.meaning: Delay between individual waves within a cluster
values.quote: each wave in a cluster hitting {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the other
values.binNote: Wiki states the intra-cluster wave delay is 0.25s, but the bin's GangplankR.CannonDelay is 0.5. These may measure different things (e.g. delay may include an initial offset), but as named this is a direct disagreement between the wiki description and the bin value; reporting the wiki's 0.25 as stated.

mechanics.claim: Cannon Barrage fires 12 waves in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds, with each wave in a cluster landing 0.25 seconds after the previous, each wave being a separate magic damage instance to all enemies in the area.
mechanics.quote: calling down 12 waves of cannonballs in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds, each wave in a cluster hitting {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the other

mechanics.claim: Each wave deals magic damage to all enemies within the area.
mechanics.quote: Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: With the Death's Daughter shop upgrade, a large cannonball lands in the center after the first cluster, dealing a cluster's worth of true damage as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: A large cannonball lands in the center of the barrage after the first cluster of waves occur, dealing a cluster's worth of {{as|true damage}} to enemies within the impact

mechanics.claim: With the Fire at Will shop upgrade, Cannon Barrage fires 18 total waves in clusters of 3 every ~1.33 seconds instead of 12 waves every 2 seconds, increasing total damage output.
mechanics.quote: ''Cannon Barrage'' fires{{ft|6 additional waves|2 additional clusters}}over its duration; 18 waves of cannonballs are called down in clusters of 3 every {{fd|1.3{{recurring|3}}}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast, not on completion of the barrage.
